scope.entry: First two-consecutive-hour confirmation of the Sep18 provisional daily recovery hypothesis; enter next actual five-minute open. Conditional on being flat then, not a claim that the entire first-leg strategy creates this state.
scope.hold_exit: Reuse prior study B: at least two daily indicator first differences are negative AND completed daily close strictly below the prior daily low. No five-day endpoint liquidation or +12%/5% partial trail.
scope.initial_structure_stop: First completed hourly close strictly below the already observed signal-day low at entry. Fixed from information known at entry; never widened. Next actual five-minute opening reference.
scope.control: At the same entry, compare the prior 50% C plus 50% A scenario. Do not compare different entry prices as exit-rule performance.
scope.tomorrow: 2026-09-27 KST. No future price is available. Report current marked equity and hypothetical current liquidation separately; no realized sale on Sep27 and no scheduled action.
scope.caveat: Single-asset, post-outcome design review. The Sep16 false reentry signal is not solved by selecting the Sep18 case. No runtime changes, no orders, no claims of independent validation.

limits: Conditional Sep18 entry only, not a fully validated reentry strategy.
Current liquidation is hypothetical, not a future Sep27 sale.
Whole-hour close confirmation can miss intra-hour breaks; drawdown metric uses five-minute closes.
